_comment: Canonical-3 success criteria still UNMET, fed to the non-blocking spec-criteria-stop hook. Maintained by the operator / /prism-verify. When a criterion is closed WITH EVIDENCE, remove it. Empty `unmet` => hook is silent. These are STEP-4 (app-feature) work, deliberately NOT done in STEP-3.

unmet.note: Single bundled `three`; runtime player still loads three/three-webgpu/three-tsl via a CDN import-map (INV-R1). Remove the split.
galaxy<->canvas<->preview-app must mount no second scene/canvas and never split-pane; selection survives every transition.
Build pop-transition (sphere -> coded position -> artifact runs) not verified.

preview-app must reuse canvas's mounted objects in place (INV-R4); page.tsx currently mounts PrismHost (a separate compiled player) XOR GraphScene. Preview-as-compile must become an in-place state transition.
Default viewMode on boot == preview-app; confirm in running app.
Galaxy free mouse/scroll nav + click-to-zoom-and-lock to target.
Deep zoom must reach any single node (current zoom is too shallow).
edit->save->build->verify->preview must be a single VERIFYING path; a failing edit is not previewable and dispatches caption-driven repair.
Exactly one edit/save/build path; retire the legacy VisualPreview regen-API second path (FP-NE-5).
